class.name: CbDirector
class.brief_description: Runs the CbReaction nodes under it from cues and entity state. Plain Godot: anything can drive it.
class.description: The World node: entities (nodes told about with [method add_entity]) carry their kind, template and state as metadata, and every [CbReaction] under it registers itself. In the game the Cinderbox client drives it; the Cue Preview panel and tests drive one by hand.

method.name: check_scene
method.description: Why a scene must not be used, or an empty string when it may: a look is made of listed node classes and data only. It is refused for a node class that is not listed, a script, a signal connection, a node path that leaves the scene, or an animation that calls an unlisted method.

method.name: instantiate
method.description: An instance of the scene, or [code]null[/code] (with a warning) when [method check_scene] refuses it. Use it for every scene a mod can replace.

method.name: press
method.description: The viewer (the entity given to [method set_local]) pressed an action. Every [CbPrediction] under the director for that action whose conditions hold plays its cue now, at the local entity, for the reactions that need nothing but that. When [method cue] is then called with the same name for the local entity (within a second), it plays only the reactions that waited: the ones that use the cue's point, end, value or other entity. Returns how many cues were predicted.

method.name: pending_predictions
method.description: The predictions still waiting for the server's cue, oldest first: [code]{ cue, age, changes, stance, stance_layer }[/code] each. Whoever drives the director applies what they say for the local entity (the Cinderbox viewer does).

method.name: explain_press
method.description: What [method press] would do, without doing it: for each [CbPrediction], [code]"predicts pistol.fired"[/code] or why not.

method.name: add_entity
method.description: Makes [param node] an entity: [code]^[/code] stops at it, and it can have state. With an [param id], state fields can name it: [code]$local@pickup.target[/code].

method.name: set_state
method.description: Replaces an entity's named values: [code]{"melee.hot": true}[/code]. Shown as its [code]state[/code] metadata.

method.name: set_world_state
method.description: The world's named values (plain names fall back to them; [code]$world:[/code] reads them).

method.name: set_known
method.description: Names that exist even where no state holds them: [code]?name[/code] is true for them.

method.name: cue
method.description: Something happened: the reactions listening for [param name] act. [param args]: [code]value[/code], [code]strength[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]end[/code].

method.name: explain
method.description: What that cue would do, without doing it: each listening reaction's path, and "acts" or why not.

method.name: update
method.description: Re-checks every "while" reaction (every frame, unless [member auto_update] is off).

members.member: Call [method update] every frame. The Cinderbox client turns it off and updates after the entities have moved.

signal.name: screen_effect
signal.description: A reaction shook the camera or flashed the screen: whoever draws the screen applies it.
